description: Since protocol 0.28: whether a real board, opened with serial.open's expect, prints what its project expects. As sim.expect, timed on the board's own clock: the project's seconds plus five, from the open and from each reconnection (a board may have printed its start before the port was opened: resetting it shows it again).

missing.description: Patterns not seen yet. Empty: the output is as expected.

needs.description: What the output needs beyond the board: none, wifi (the simulated network reaches nothing), or parts (the project's parts on the Circuit dock).

seconds.description: How long a board takes to print it all.
